Name: NPC Teleport
Author: lilithds
Description:
[size=5][b]NPC Teleport[/b][/size]

Can't find Abigail? Need to hand Linus a gift before bedtime? Press a key, pick a villager, and you're standing next to them.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]F9 menu[/b]: every villager with their portrait and current location, sorted by name.[/*]
[*][b]Search[/b]: just start typing to filter. [b]Enter[/b] teleports to the first match, [b]Esc[/b] closes.[/*]
[*][b]Social tab[/b]: right-click a villager to get a "Teleport to ...?" prompt.[/*]
[*][b]Console command[/b]: [font=Courier New]tp_npc <name>[/font] (partial names work). [font=Courier New]tp_npc[/font] with no name lists every NPC and where they are.[/*]
[*]You land on a free tile beside the NPC, facing them.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[font=Courier New]config.json[/font] is created in the mod folder on first launch.
[list]
[*][b]OpenMenuKey[/b] (default [font=Courier New]F9[/font]): any SMAPI keybind, e.g. [font=Courier New]"F9, LeftShoulder + RightShoulder"[/font].[/*]
[*][b]VillagersOnly[/b] (default [font=Courier New]true[/font]): set [font=Courier New]false[/font] to also list pets, horses and other characters.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download with Vortex, or unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Works with custom NPCs from content packs.[/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove mid-save. No save data is written.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: not tested yet.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Search bar in the F9 menu (just start typing).[/*]
[*]Right-click → teleport in the Social tab.[/*]
[*]Enter teleports to the first result, Esc closes.[/*]
[/list][b]1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Initial release: F9 menu and tp_npc console command.[/*]
[/list]
Bug reports and suggestions welcome in the Posts or Bugs tab. Please include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].
